capabilities.name: portfolio_stats_profits_activity
capabilities.event_at: activity.timestamp for individual activity; aggregate stats are window summaries
capabilities.observed_at: NOT PROVIDED; wrapper must stamp local request_before/response_after/observed_at
capabilities.provenance: GMGN OpenAPI / platform-computed wallet analytics plus activity records
capabilities.rate_limit: weighted API; exact route weight should be read from CLI docs/headers at sampling time
capabilities.missingness: route-specific envelopes; missing must remain missing
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: UNSAFE retrospectively for aggregates unless an actual earlier snapshot was stored; activity rows can be filtered by timestamp but platform labels/derived values still need provenance caution
capabilities.lookahead_risk: HIGH for current aggregate PnL/winrate queried after the target event
capabilities.survivorship_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH if only known/successful wallets are queried
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: partial: raw chain participant identity and opportunity-association history; not full wallet-wide GMGN PnL
capabilities.potential_incremental_value: HIGH if prospectively snapshotted before/at signal T0

capabilities.name: portfolio_holdings
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: current balances can be read from chain if needed
capabilities.decision: Do not configure or use GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY in this audit; skip holdings.

capabilities.name: portfolio_created_tokens
capabilities.command: gmgn-cli portfolio created-tokens --chain sol --wallet <deployer> --order-by token_ath_mc --direction desc --raw
capabilities.historical_availability: up to 100 token rows plus aggregate counts
capabilities.missingness: tokens list may be truncated; total created is inner_count + open_count, not len(tokens)
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: SAFE only as a prospective snapshot; current ATH/open status can change after target T0
capabilities.lookahead_risk: HIGH for retrospective ATH/open_ratio unless captured at/ before target T0
capabilities.survivorship_risk: MEDIUM; must include all prior launches, not only migrated/successful
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: not yet complete; deployer-history acquisition is currently missing

capabilities.name: track_smartmoney
capabilities.purpose: Early participant evidence / competitive participant benchmark
capabilities.created_at: base token metadata may expose creation time depending response
capabilities.update_frequency: real-time feed semantics claimed; exact refresh cadence must be measured
capabilities.historical_availability: latest feed; exact retained horizon not established
capabilities.rate_limit: documented route weight 1; rough sustained budget ~20 req/s under full bucket model
capabilities.missingness: platform tags and records can be absent
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: event rows usable only if local observed_at proves arrival before decision cutoff; smart-money classification itself may be updated later
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: raw trade events yes; Smart Money classification no

capabilities.name: track_kol
capabilities.historical_availability: latest feed; exact retained horizon not established
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: requires event timestamp + local observed_at; KOL label may be mutable
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: raw trade yes; KOL mapping no

capabilities.name: market_trenches_new_creation
capabilities.purpose: Launch coverage/timing benchmark and structural snapshot
capabilities.command: gmgn-cli market trenches --chain sol --type new_creation --launchpad-platform Pump.fun --limit 80 --raw
capabilities.provenance: GMGN Trenches launch list + platform-computed current metrics
capabilities.measured_expected_latency: timing sample required versus chain T0 / our observed_at
capabilities.historical_availability: new_creation / near_completion / completed list views, not a guaranteed event archive
capabilities.rate_limit: inspect headers/CLI behavior; not fixed in audited excerpt
capabilities.missingness: platform/filter defaults can silently change coverage; explicit Pump.fun filter required
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: created_timestamp is historical identity; dynamic metrics require prospective snapshot
capabilities.lookahead_risk: LOW for creation timestamp, HIGH for dynamic fields when backfilled
capabilities.survivorship_risk: LOW if all new_creation sampled; HIGH if only completed used
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: our chain T0/observed_at is primary; many structural fields only partial
capabilities.potential_incremental_value: MEDIUM for alpha, HIGH for timing/coverage benchmark

capabilities.name: market_completed
capabilities.command: gmgn-cli market trenches --chain sol --type completed --launchpad-platform Pump.fun --raw
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: outcome-only; never predictor source for pre-completion decision unless fields were snapshotted earlier
capabilities.lookahead_risk: EXTREME if used as launch predictor retrospectively
capabilities.survivorship_risk: EXTREME if analyzed without all-launch denominator
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: migration/completion can be derived from chain

capabilities.name: market_trending_hot
capabilities.event_at: no event timestamp for ranking itself in audited schema
capabilities.update_frequency: interval-specific ranking snapshot; exact refresh cadence must be measured
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: only current snapshot is safe at local observation time
capabilities.survivorship_risk: HIGH because ranked list selects already-attended tokens
capabilities.potential_incremental_value: LOW as causal alpha, HIGH as competitive timing benchmark

capabilities.name: token_info

capabilities.point_in_time_safety: static identity/mapping safer; current market/holder/tag fields require prospective snapshot
capabilities.lookahead_risk: LOW for token address/creator mapping if stable; HIGH for dynamic metrics

capabilities.name: token_security
